svg.text: Autonomous USB bootstrap; GPIO high-current mode requires a validated >=1.5 A PD contract. Motor ENN stays high at 5 V.
100 nF dVdt capacitor + 100 ohm series: nominal slew 0.020 V/ms. 6.65k gives 0.50 A; parallel branch gives about 1.01 A.
Latch-off faults require power cycle or UVLO toggle. Reverse blocking is not a regenerative brake; motor energy limits still require qualification.
